sinopsis.es: Tres héroes improbables, un coatí de espíritu libre, una intrépida mariposa monarca y una hiperactiva rana de cristal, se lanzan a una aventura para impedir que la malvada serpiente coral Zaina destruya su selva.
sinopsis.en: Three unlikely heroes, a free-spirited coati, a fearless monarch butterfly and a hyperactive glass frog, embark on an adventure to stop the wicked coral snake Zaina from destroying their rainforest homeland.
